summary.text: Justin Holliday is the Democratic candidate for Maryland State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Johnny Ray Salling (R) is also running.
A public school teacher and union representative from Dundalk, he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Holliday graduated from Patapsco High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Baltimore in 2018, and his career has included work as a teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father, public school teacher, union representative and lifelong Dundalk resident raising his daughter there.

Holliday's survey answers named affordability, state funding for Southeast Baltimore County roads, schools and the Back River Wastewater Treatment Plant, public education and public safety among his priorities.
